steps.message:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-08 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 225.6 | 4.98 | 4.98
2 | 217.6 | 7.63 | 12.61
3 | 626.8 | 19.10 | 31.71
4 | 694.3 | 0.32 | 32.03
5 | 580.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as Q-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Reference note: Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station: T-08
Curve type: HAK (recalculated from the resistivity sequence 225.6→217.6→626.8→694.3→580.5; note this does not match the Q-type classification on file, since resistivity is not monotonically decreasing — layer 2 is a low-resistivity zone flanked by higher-resistivity layers 1 and 3, followed by a rise then fall)
Aquifer depth: approximately 4.98–12.61 m (Layer 2, the low-resistivity unit indicative of a saturated/water-bearing zone)
Recommendation: Flag the on-file Q-type classification for review, as the raw data actually describe an H-A-K sequence; target drilling and screen placement in the 4.98–12.61 m interval where resistivity drops to 217.6 ohm-m, and confirm lithology with cuttings/logging during drilling to verify the aquifer boundary before setting casing.
